title: Account Management Note: A Smaller Workforce and the Early Termination Fee
content:
A smaller workforce lowers the early termination fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. The reduction is the highest eligible headcount any census of the agreement shows less the eligible headcount of the census with the latest census month, divided by that highest headcount:

- where it is at least 0.2 (20 percent), the fee is multiplied by 0.5;
- where it is at least 0.1 (10 percent) but below 0.2, by 0.85;
- otherwise it is not multiplied.

## Judgement table (hypothetical censuses)

| Highest census headcount | Latest census headcount | Reduction | Fee multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1250 | 1000 | 0.2 | 0.5 |
| 1200 | 1000 | about 0.167 | 0.85 |
| 1100 | 990 | 0.1 | 0.85 |
| 1100 | 1000 | about 0.091 | not multiplied |
| 1000 | 1000 | 0 | not multiplied |
